title: Approval decision
description: schema_version 2 (from F1b): every new record has global_id and install_id; whatever writes one stamps both, the install id read through stella_data.install_id(). schema_version 1: a record from before the ids; it is never rewritten, it is read and validated as it is, and it is still found by what identified it then (its request_id). The schema subset has no conditional, so the schema accepts either version with the ids optional; that a version 2 record has both is the writer's rule.

global_id.description: This record's UUID (lower case, version 4), unique: no two records share one.

install_id.description: The UUID of the install that wrote the record.
